grains.RAW.MERCH_LINES: one row per merchandise line (Singapore planning area and product category)
grains.RAW.LINE_DAILY: one row per line per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.FUNDING_AGREEMENTS: one row per line (supplier funding agreement snapshot)
grains.CURATED.EXCEPTION_SUMMARY: one row per pricing exception type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide pricing-exception FORECAST; markdown depth ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.EXCEPTION_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic pricing exception handling SOPs (one per product category and exception type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.MERCHANDISING_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.MERCHANDISING_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, merchandise line, exception-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (merchandise lines, daily pricing exceptions, unplanned markdowns by line, unplanned-markdown risk, POS events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_POS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_POS_ALERT logs new EXCEPTION events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.markdown_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(unplanned markdown for the line in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE

scope: Tembusu Fresh Mart, a fictional Singapore supermarket chain; 48 merchandise lines in five Singapore planning areas (Bukit Batok, Sengkang, Toa Payoh, Bedok, Yishun); synthetic data in SGD
